caption: Figure 2. An example of LMM that uses a large language model as the backbone. The user prompt consists of an image and a video clip, and is converted into tokens by corresponding modality encoders, which are further processed by the backbone model to produce the response in multimodal text or speech
subject: how one multimodal prompt (text+image+video) is tokenized by 3 modality encoders, processed by the backbone, and decoded to audio/image
